layers.title: Terrain height
layers.processing: Cut to the site's box and stored as height tiles for zoom 11 to 15, to the nearest 0.1 m. One tile pixel at zoom 15 is 1.7 m on the ground, so the 3D view is smoother than the 1 m grid. Past the edge of the box the edge height is repeated so the surface has no cliff; that is not data.
